label: Updated at 8 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Wyndham Championship Win
items.text: Michael Brennan leads the Wyndham Championship at 22-under, beating Beau Hossler by three shots and earning 500 FedExCup points and $1,530,000.

items.headline: Houston Open Leader
items.text: Gary Woodland leads the Texas Children's Houston Open at 21-under, ahead of Nicolai Højgaard at 16-under and Johnny Keefer at 15-under.

items.headline: Historic 3M Open Score
items.text: Jackson Koivun leads the 3M Open at 25-under, with Scottie Scheffler and Hideki Matsuyama trailing at 22-under and 20-under respectively.
